employees.label: Employees (Company scope)
employees.definition: ESG report 'Number of employees by geographic region'. Covers the Company's permanent employees plus consultants and interns directly employed by the Company (58,350 total), excluding subsidiaries and consolidated investment companies; the group total in the annual report is 110,558.

notes: The 2024 annual report gives only the group headcount (110,558 at Dec 31, 2024) with no geographic split. The ESG report splits a narrower Company-scope headcount (58,350, excluding subsidiaries and consolidated investees) into 'The Mainland of China' and 'Others' (Others is not defined by country, so it is a region with countries null). No province-level, country-level tax or site counts are published. 'Others' is labelled here as outside the Mainland of China; the report's own label is 'Others'.
